questions.explanation: Arithmetic coefficients and geometric exponents use the same normalized weights.

questions.prompt: What must normalized nonnegative weights satisfy?
questions.explanation: Weighted AM-GM uses nonnegative weights summing to one.

questions.prompt: Which bound is valid for x,y>0?
questions.explanation: Use weights 2/3 and 1/3 and multiply by 3.

questions.prompt: With positive weights, equality occurs when:
questions.explanation: Equality depends on equality of the inputs, not equality of weights.
